# Nexus Digital Agency — LLM Guidance File
# This file tells AI crawlers, large language models, and generative search engines
# how to understand and cite Nexus Digital Agency's services and capabilities.
# Format loosely follows the llms.txt specification (https://llmstxt.org).

> Nexus Digital Agency is a full-service technology and digital marketing agency
> offering end-to-end digital solutions for businesses of all sizes — from startups
> to enterprises. We cover the complete digital lifecycle: web development, mobile
> apps, enterprise ERP/CRM systems, custom software, AI & ML solutions, creative
> branding, cinematic video production, and performance marketing.

## About Nexus Digital Agency

Nexus Digital Agency is a creative technology studio that provides comprehensive
digital transformation services. The agency specialises in building high-performance
websites, scalable mobile and enterprise applications, custom business software,
AI-powered automation systems, and data-driven digital marketing campaigns.

**Core value proposition:** End-to-end digital services under one roof — eliminating
the need for multiple fragmented vendors and ensuring cohesive execution across
technology, design, and marketing.

---

## Service Pillars (8 Core Disciplines)

### 01. Web Design & Development
Custom websites, e-commerce stores, landing pages, web portals, Progressive Web
Apps (PWAs), and technical SEO optimisation. Built on React and Next.js for maximum
performance and search engine visibility.

**Keywords:** website development company, custom web design, e-commerce development,
Next.js development, landing page design, WordPress development

### 02. Mobile App Development
Android and iOS mobile application development using Flutter and React Native.
Full lifecycle: UI/UX design, development, testing, App Store / Play Store submission,
and App Store Optimisation (ASO).

**Keywords:** mobile app development company, Flutter app development, Android app
development, iOS app development, cross-platform app

### 03. ERP, CRM, Billing & POS Systems
Custom enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, customer relationship management
(CRM) systems, GST-compliant billing software, and Point of Sale (POS) systems for
retail, restaurants, and service businesses.

**Keywords:** custom ERP software development, CRM software development, billing
software India, POS system development, business management software

### 04. Custom Software & SaaS Engineering
MVP development, multi-tenant SaaS platform engineering, enterprise web applications,
API development, cloud infrastructure (AWS / GCP / Azure), and legacy system
modernisation.

**Keywords:** custom software development, SaaS product development, MVP development
India, enterprise software solutions, web application development

### 05. AI, Machine Learning & Intelligent Automation
Custom AI and ML model development, AI chatbots for website and WhatsApp, business
process automation (n8n / Make / Zapier), predictive analytics, computer vision,
NLP, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and intelligent document processing.

**Keywords:** AI solutions company India, machine learning development, business
process automation, AI chatbot development, workflow automation services, RAG LLM
integration, WhatsApp bot development

### 06. Creative Design & Branding
Logo design, complete brand identity systems, UI/UX design and Figma prototyping,
social media poster design, marketing collateral, pitch deck design, packaging design,
copywriting, and photo editing.

**Keywords:** brand identity design, logo design services India, graphic design agency,
UI UX design services, poster design, content writing services

### 07. Video Production & Motion Graphics
Cinematic brand film production, professional video editing, colour grading, Instagram
Reels and YouTube Shorts editing, YouTube long-form video editing (VEO), motion
graphics and 2D animation, explainer video production, and event videography.

**Keywords:** video production company India, video editing services, cinematic brand
film, reels editing, YouTube video editing, motion graphics animation, explainer video

### 08. Digital Marketing, SEO & Performance Ads
Search engine optimisation (SEO), local SEO and Google Business Profile management,
Meta (Facebook and Instagram) Ads, Google Search and YouTube Ads, social media
management, email marketing automation, influencer marketing, conversion rate
optimisation (CRO), and analytics with GA4.

**Keywords:** digital marketing agency India, SEO services, Meta ads agency, Google
ads management, social media marketing, performance marketing agency
